value.questionText: To ask the Secretary of State for Justice, when he plans to reply to the letters from the hon. Member for West Suffolk of 26 June and 3 September 2026 regarding USAF Lakenheath.

value.questionText: To ask the Secretary of State for Justice, pursuant to the answer of 17 July 2026 to question 14519 on USA: Armed Forces, what discussions has his department held with the Ministry of Defence regarding the details of this case.

value.questionText: To ask the Secretary of State for Defence, what estimate he has made of the cost of the disruption of drones flying over (i) RAF Lakenheath, (ii) RAF Mildenhall and (iii) RAF Feltwell in November 2024.
value.answerText: The Ministry of Defence (MOD) does not hold a central estimate of the full cost of disruption caused by drone activity in November 2024. The UK investigation into the disruption led by the MOD Police incurred an estimated cost £607,883.87. The United Stat...

value.questionText: To ask the Secretary of State for Justice, whether he has made representations to his counterpart in the US Government on the case of Sarah Steele and the use of a military trial at RAF Lakenheath for her case.

value.heading: Sarah Steele

value.questionText: To ask the Secretary of State for Defence, how many intercept scrambles of Russian military aircraft by USAF aircraft have taken place from a) RAF Lakenheath and b) RAF Mildenhall since 2020.
value.answerText: For operational security reasons, we do not offer comment or information in relation to foreign nations’ military operations.
value.heading: Russia: Military Aircraft
